audit_0600_note: the 2026-10-02T0600Z audit of the previous run (its AUDIT.md) sampled 20 units (u074, u111, 14 READINGS, 4 LABELLED) and rejected three; the sample is stratified, so 17/20 is not a corpus rate

audit_0600_repairs.u051: Rejected 2026-10-02T0600Z (the avoiding duties applied only if the person is persecuted, so a person seeking asylum from threatened persecution fell outside the guard). Repaired: the guard is the base relation 'the person seeks or enjoys asylum from persecution' (suffered or threatened), a checked scope that does not require persecution to have occurred; the open term persecution gains the factor 'whether persecution that is only threatened counts'. Pending a fresh independent audit.
audit_0600_repairs.u054: Rejected 2026-10-02T0600Z (both asserted readings turned a right to a nationality into an accomplished fact). Repaired: the asserted readings are dropped; the set holds an entitlement (each person must receive a nationality; the source names no bearer, so none is named) and a liberty (each person is permitted to have a nationality), as norm-defaults@0 companions with the completion unspecified. 'Some state must grant it' is not expressible: a norm cannot be an existential over bearers. Pending a fresh independent audit.
audit_0600_repairs.u111: Rejected 2026-10-02T0600Z (the limitation reported zero limitation terms, so it constrained none of the rights). Repaired: the rights@0 limitation is dropped and the unit holds norm candidates over a limitation argument whose guard is the negation of the source's necessary conditions (determined by law; solely for the listed aims), so a limitation that misses a condition is settled (the person must be free of it) and one that meets them is UNDECIDED (the conditions are necessary, never sufficient). Four candidates: 'solely for the purpose of A and of B' as one or both of the two aims, or as both aims; 'shall' as strict (norm-defaults@0) or defeasible (soft-norms@0, completion 'deny' = not required). Pending a fresh independent audit.

audit_1001_repairs.u033b: Rejected 2026-09-30T1800Z (label: a negative 'avoid inciting discrimination' candidate dropped 'equal protection'). Repaired: one polarity, the positive duty 'protect equally against incitement to such discrimination' (65 bytes, the anaphor kept).
audit_1001_repairs.u041: Rejected 2026-09-30T1800Z (weakened: both duties dropped 'in a public trial at which he has had all the guarantees necessary for his defence'). The whole clause (according to law, in a public trial, with all guarantees necessary for the defence) needs more than the 80 bytes of an act phrase, and carrying only part of it is the defect the audit found, so the unit leaves READINGS and is UNFORMALISED (other:act_phrase_grammar). The open term guarantees_necessary_for_defence stays declared. Its holder sort charged_person is dropped.
audit_1001_repairs.u046: Rejected 2026-09-30T1800Z (weakened). Repaired: the act phrase is 'protect by law against such interference as well as attacks' (67 bytes), the source's own anaphor; 'such interference or attacks' is read from u045a and u045b in the reason (not a checked reference); 'or' is worded 'as well as'.
audit_1001_repairs.u063: Not sampled; same defect class (the duties dropped 'alone as well as in association with others'). The duties now say 'alone as well as jointly with others' / 'alone as well as with others'. Pending a fresh audit.

audit_1002_note: the 2026-10-01T1800Z audit of the previous run (its AUDIT.md) sampled 20 units and rejected four; its sample is stratified, so 16/20 is not a corpus rate

audit_1002_repairs.u035: Rejected 2026-10-01T1800Z (the checked duty had no argument for the rights-violating act; prose holder). Repaired with norm-defaults@0: the duty ranges over (tribunal or State, act) and a guard 'the act violates a fundamental right granted to a person by the constitution or by law' carries the scope as checked structure; the bearer is named by a guard (a competent national tribunal, or a State that must ensure tribunals provide the remedy). The victim is not an argument (predicates have at most two); it is the person whose right the act violates, in the act phrase. Pending a fresh independent audit.
audit_1002_repairs.u039: Rejected 2026-10-01T1800Z ('in full equality' unattached; no determination or charge argument). A repair with norm-defaults@0 (a guard on a determination argument) fits the scope but the duty 'give in full equality a fair public hearing by an independent impartial tribunal in the case' is 88 to 93 bytes, over the 80-byte act phrase; dropping 'in full equality' is the rejected defect. The unit is UNFORMALISED (other:act_phrase_grammar).
audit_1002_repairs.u051: Rejected 2026-10-01T1800Z (strengthened and incomplete: the positive candidates required every bearer to grant asylum to every person and omitted seeking). Repaired with norm-defaults@0: no positive grant candidate; the reading set is a liberty (a person may seek and enjoy asylum from persecution in other countries) and the avoiding duty, bound on every State or on every bearer, whose act phrase says 'seeking as well as enjoying' and whose guard 'the person is seeking or enjoying asylum from persecution' carries 'from persecution' as a checked scope. Pending a fresh independent audit.
audit_1002_repairs.u077: Rejected 2026-10-01T1800Z (no checked relation connected a bearer to the holder's country, so unrelated bearers were bound). Repaired with norm-defaults@0: the guard is a base relation between the bearer and the person; 'his country' is read two ways in the reading set (the country of which the person is a national, the country in which the person resides) because the source does not say. Pending a fresh independent audit.

language_findings: force: a strict and a defeasible right candidate need different base predicates (the defeasible one adds its exception decision), so a reading set cannot hold both and no single checked situation separates them; force is therefore fixed strict for units without a weakening word, and the 43 'shall' and Articles 22-27 units stay UNFORMALISED

act phrases: at most 80 bytes, plain words only, no 'and', 'or', 'for', 'no', 'not', 'is', 'if', each slot once; lists are worded with 'as well as' and long clauses are shortened, with the full clause in the predicate description

size: at most 64 regulated predicates per environment; four readings per right (two polarities, two bearers) cost two predicates per right once the two bearer readings share predicates through an is_state guard

reading-set candidates must be whole right blocks: 'this right includes ...' (right_lines), limitations and bars cannot be candidates, so u067, u068, u071a, u071b stay blocked and Article 30's bar is not used

limitation and bar act on rights lines fixed in the document; here every line is a reading-set candidate, so a rights@0 limitation would have empty scope (limitation_terms 0) until per-choice elaboration exists: u111 therefore states its necessary conditions as norm candidates over a limitation argument (guards), which constrain no rights line; the link from a limitation to a particular right is not expressible
document reading sets cannot hold norm content, so u017, u052, u112, u114 keep companion documents for their norm candidates
load time: validating 14 right reading sets takes about 35 seconds per document load

entitlement without a bearer: a right whose source names no bearer (u054) can be a norm over the holder as the passive subject ('each person must receive a nationality') or a liberty; 'some state must grant it' needs an existential over bearers that a norm cannot state, and a right block would bind every state (the rejected strengthening)

prospective harm: 'asylum from persecution' includes threatened persecution, so the guard of u051 is the person's asylum seeking (a base relation whose description covers suffered or threatened persecution), not the person's being persecuted; whether the persecution is real stays the named open term persecution

necessary conditions: a prohibition guarded by the negation of the conditions (u111) settles every case that misses a condition and reports UNDECIDED for the cases that meet them, so 'only' limitations of this kind is never read as 'all' limitations of this kind are permitted

norm-defaults@0 and soft-norms@0 still cannot share a document: the two defeasible candidates of u111 (as that of u017) are soft-norms@0 companions with the declared completion 'deny' on an obligation-role predicate (= not required), so they invent no permission

norm-defaults@0 cannot be enabled together with soft-norms@0 or rights@0 (UnsupportedProfile: norm-defaults@0 documents on the soft and rights routes await the Lean route): the 14 right-block reading sets keep their declared 'deny' completions ('not required'), u074 keeps 'allow' in the main document, and the defeasible candidate of u017 keeps 'deny'; every norm candidate that can live in a norms@0 document is a companion with the completion unspecified

predicates have at most two arguments: a duty with a bearer, a beneficiary and a case (remedy for an act, hearing in a determination) must fold one of them into a sort, so the victim of u035 and the person of u039 are not arguments

act phrases are still at most 80 bytes in norm-defaults@0 documents: u039 ('give in full equality a fair public hearing by an independent impartial tribunal in the case', 88 to 93 bytes) cannot be stated without dropping a clause
norm candidates of a reading set hold no content in the main document (they are cited by meaning id from companion documents), so the main document's premise verdict stays UNKNOWN

no_invented_permissions.claims: every claim predicate is obligation-role with completion 'deny' (= not required); no permission predicate is used for a duty, so no prohibition makes anything permitted for anyone else. The state reading is the same duty guarded by is_state: for non-states its completion is 'not required', declared and not derived from the source (witnesses.json shows the rule decides every state under both completions and that dropping it loses the conclusion)
no_invented_permissions.liberties: the seven liberty predicates are permission-role with completion 'deny' (the tool requires some completion); in the liberty reading the rule is unconditional over the whole person sort, so the completion is never consulted (witnesses.json, both completions); in the other readings the predicate is mentioned by no rule. This stray declaration is flagged for the audit
no_invented_permissions.polarity_repairs: u029, u032, u033a, u033b, u046, u049 carry one duty (or the avoiding duty plus a liberty); no 'allow' reading of a prohibition was added
